note: The carried lights (P.O.C.K.E.T.; lineage B10 and B11: four kinds). One table: the server reads it (src/frameworks/lost/server/sim.level0.js: the light a player's equipment gives, which the monsters perceive) and the page's compiled client is built with it (src/core/client/game/shared/equipment.ts: LIGHT_SPECS, through level-data.cjs). range: reach, px; arc: spread, rad (the lantern's 6.283185307179586 is 2 pi, the double Math.PI * 2 gives); power: strength; spill: px; omni: lights all around; nv: night vision, no light (the camcorder). The labels are the page's (the server never read its own; until C4c it labelled the camcorder "Night Vision Camcorder").
